item.description: US President Donald Trump has denied plans to replace the press briefing room with a historic swimming pool. item.title: Florida couple builds 420-acre animal sanctuary
item.description: Erin and Chris Amerman acquired a 210-acre farm in 2015 and established Critter Creek Farm Sanctuary. They expanded their efforts to include a 200-acre ranch named Critter Hills in 2019. The sanctuary now shelters over 180 cows along with various other animals requiring care. Monthly tours and events aim to promote compassion for all animals. Their work emphasizes the need for space and resources to continue animal rescue efforts. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: After six years of ownership, Selena Gomez has sold her Encino residence for $5.399 million, which is less than the listed price of $6.5 million. This iconic property, formerly owned by Tom Petty, was the backdrop for her series 'Selena + Chef'. In December 2024, she purchased a stunning Beverly Hills estate for $35 million, ultimately marrying music producer Benny Blanco in September 2025 not long after getting engaged. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
